en: Tracking App Install Sources on Android with the Play Install Referrer Library
zh: 使用 Play Install Referrer 库在 Android 上追踪应用安装来源

excerpts.zh: 安装来源追踪把推广链接和应用首次安装连接起来。
excerpts.en: Install attribution connects a campaign link with an app installation.

excerpts.zh: 渠道参数进入应用后，才能用于后续的转化分析。
excerpts.en: Campaign parameters must reach the app before they can support conversion analysis.

excerpts.zh: 连接 Google Play 是异步过程，需要分别处理成功、不支持和服务不可用。
excerpts.en: Connecting to Google Play is asynchronous and requires handling different outcomes.

excerpts.zh: 连接断开后，需要考虑如何重新建立连接。
excerpts.en: A disconnected service needs a reconnection strategy.

excerpts.zh: 读取来源信息后，应当释放连接和相关资源。
excerpts.en: After reading attribution data, release the connection and associated resources.

excerpts.zh: 本地安装和经 Google Play 下载的安装，需要用不同场景验证。
excerpts.en: Local installs and Google Play installs need separate test scenarios.
